title: Diffusion Models Through a Global Lens: Are They Culturally Inclusive?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image diffusion models on their ability to accurately generate culturally specific artifacts (architecture, clothing, and food) across ten countries representing both overrepresented and underrepresented cultures. The evaluation compares AI-generated images to real-world reference images using human annotations for visual similarity, description match, and realism, alongside a proposed automated neural image-image similarity metric (CULTDIFF-S).
